checklistGeneric: Tracking run to the agreed frequency
Figures reconciled to the ceded ledger
checklistSpecific: Compare ceded written and earned premium by treaty against the placement plan
Compare notified and paid reinsurance recoveries against the expected recovery pattern
Identify recoveries overdue beyond the treaty settlement terms and list them by reinsurer
Include reinstatement premiums triggered to date in the tracked position
Reconcile the tracked ceded premium and recoveries to the ceded accounting balances

testing.location: Ceded premium and recovery tracking report
testing.expected: Tracking report comparing ceded premium and recoveries to plan by treaty with aged overdue recoveries listed
No unreconciled difference between the tracking report and the ceded accounting balances

checklistGeneric: Every action has an owner and due date
Status refreshed to the agreed cadence
checklistSpecific: Update the status of each approved steering action against its target completion date
Confirm placed remediation is bound and recorded in the reinsurance administration system before closing the action
Confirm underwriting actions such as reduced line sizes are reflected in current authority limits
Report the residual net exposure after implemented actions against the target
Escalate actions overdue beyond the agreed tolerance to the Head of Reinsurance

testing.expected: Action tracker showing status, owner, and due date for every approved steering decision
No action closed without evidence that the remediation was executed

checklistGeneric: Analysis covers all classes being renewed
Conclusions reviewed before use in planning
checklistSpecific: Collect broker market reports on capacity and rate-on-line movement by class and territory
Record the loss activity and major catastrophe events driving the current market cycle
Assess capacity available from the existing panel versus new markets for each layer
Summarise expected rate change per program with a range rather than a single point
State the implication for the renewal strategy including where terms should be tested early

testing.expected: Dated market analysis covering capacity, rate movement by class, and expected renewal rate range per program

checklistGeneric: Pack contents checked against the market requirement list
checklistSpecific: Include the exposure profile by band, class, and territory as at the agreed submission date
Include at least five and preferably ten years of loss history with large losses listed individually
Include the cat model output summary with model name, version, and assumptions stated
Include the proposed structure with attachment, limit, and reinstatement terms per layer
Reconcile submission premium and exposure figures to the policy and ceded systems before release

testing.expected: Complete submission pack with exposure profile, loss history, cat model summary, and proposed structure
No submission figure that does not reconcile to the underlying policy or ceded system data

checklistGeneric: Dates agreed with the parties involved
checklistSpecific: Set the dates for data cut-off, submission release, quote deadline, firm order, and signing for each program
Work back from each treaty inception date including off-cycle renewals
Include the internal approval milestones for strategy pre-approval and final renewal sign-off
Include broker and market meeting dates such as the renewal roadshow and Monte Carlo or Baden sessions
Publish the calendar with named owners and confirm no milestone falls after its treaty inception

testing.expected: Published calendar with data cut-off, submission, quote, firm order, and signing dates per program with owners
No milestone scheduled after the inception date of the treaty it supports

checklistSpecific: Issue the final placed structure, participants, and shares to finance, actuarial, and capital management
State the final ceded premium by program against the approved budget and explain the difference
Confirm actuarial has what it needs to update ceded reserves and the recovery pattern
Confirm capital management has the final terms needed for the capital model reinsurance module
Confirm the treaty parameters are loaded in the reinsurance administration system before the effective date

testing.location: Placed treaty records for the new period
testing.expected: Final placed structure, participants, shares, and premium loaded and shared with finance, actuarial, and capital teams

testing.location: Placed treaty records for the new period
testing.expected: No incepted treaty missing its final participant shares at the effective date

checklistGeneric: Targets consistent with the approved strategy
checklistSpecific: Agree the target rate on line, limit, and structure per layer with the broker before market release
Agree the target panel composition, lead candidates, and maximum line per reinsurer
Confirm the security criteria the broker must apply when approaching markets
Agree the fallback position if target terms are not achieved and the point at which to escalate
Record the agreed targets and brokerage terms in writing before the submission is released

testing.expected: Written confirmation of target terms, panel composition, security criteria, and brokerage before market release

checklistGeneric: All received quotes included in the comparison
checklistSpecific: Normalise every quote to a common basis of limit, reinstatements, and commission before comparing
Build the signed line scenario showing the panel, shares, and blended rate on line per layer
Check each quoting reinsurer against the approved security list and note any collateral requirement
Compare the best achievable terms to the approved target and to the budgeted spend
Recommend which quotes to firm order and which layers to re-market, with the reasons stated

testing.expected: Normalised quote comparison with panel scenario, blended rate on line, and a stated firm order recommendation
No recommended participant that fails the approved security criteria without an approved collateral arrangement

checklistGeneric: Debrief held within the agreed window after completion
Outcomes compared to the approved plan
checklistSpecific: Compare the placed structure against the approved target structure layer by layer
Compare achieved rate on line and total ceded spend against target and budget
Assess whether the intended panel and lead were secured and where capacity fell short
Identify which parts of the strategy delivered and which assumptions proved wrong
Record the conclusions as inputs to next cycle's strategy and the multi-year roadmap

testing.expected: Debrief comparing placed structure, pricing, and panel against the approved strategy with stated conclusions

checklistGeneric: Only the approved pack version is released
Distribution list matches the agreed panel
checklistSpecific: Release the approved submission pack to the agreed target markets through the broker
Confirm each approached reinsurer received the same pack version and any addendum issued
Log every quote with the reinsurer, layer, rate on line, share offered, and any conditions attached
Log declinations and the stated reason for each
Chase outstanding responses against the quote deadline in the renewal calendar

testing.expected: Quote log capturing reinsurer, layer, rate, share, conditions, and declinations against the distribution list
No approached market left with no recorded response or declination after the quote deadline

checklistGeneric: Input gathered from all involved teams
Each lesson has an owner and action
Record filed where next cycle will find it
checklistSpecific: Capture lessons on data quality and submission preparation timeliness
Capture lessons on market reception, questions raised, and information gaps that slowed quoting
Capture lessons on internal approval timing and where the calendar slipped
Convert each lesson into a specific action for the next cycle with an owner and target date
File the lessons record with the renewal calendar template so it is picked up next cycle

testing.expected: Lessons record with each lesson converted into an owned action for the next renewal cycle

checklistGeneric: Action taken only within the approved authority
checklistSpecific: Issue firm order to the broker for the approved layers, shares, and terms
Confirm signed lines are within the approved maximum line per reinsurer and the panel is fully subscribed
Confirm each participant's security rating and any required collateral or trust arrangement is in place
Obtain signed cover notes or slips for every incepted layer before the effective date
Load the final treaty terms, participants, and premium schedule into the reinsurance administration system

testing.expected: Every incepted layer holds a signed cover note with final participants, shares, and premium schedule
No layer left under-subscribed or carrying a participant outside the approved security criteria at inception

checklistGeneric: Decision recorded with the strategy version
checklistSpecific: Present the renewal strategy, target structure, and target spend for pre-approval before the market is approached
Confirm the strategy sits within the approved retention and risk appetite limits
Obtain agreement on the mandate limits within which the team may bind without returning for approval
Record any condition attached to the pre-approval, such as a maximum acceptable rate increase
File the pre-approval reference against the renewal strategy document version

testing.expected: Pre-approval record naming the strategy version, mandate limits, approver, and date, dated before market release

checklistGeneric: Strategy covers every treaty due to renew
checklistSpecific: List every treaty renewing at 1/1 and off-cycle with its inception date and current terms
State the target structure change per treaty: renew as expiring, restructure, increase limit, or non-renew
Set the target rate on line and maximum acceptable rate change for each layer
Identify treaties where the current panel should be changed and the reason
Note dependencies between treaties, including inuring order, that constrain the sequence of placement

testing.location: Renewal strategy by program and treaty
testing.expected: Strategy document covering every renewing treaty with target structure, target rate, and panel intentions
No treaty expiring in the renewal period that is missing from the strategy document

checklistGeneric: Counterparty criteria applied to every market
Plan aligned to the renewal calendar
checklistSpecific: Define the target panel per layer with the intended lead and the maximum line per reinsurer
Screen every target market against the approved security rating and counterparty concentration limits
Set the placement approach per layer: firm order, quote-and-sign, or open market
Set the sequence and timing of market meetings against the renewal calendar milestones
Obtain approval of the market engagement plan before any market is approached

testing.expected: Approved plan naming target panel, lead, maximum lines, placement approach, and timeline per layer
No target market included that fails the approved security or concentration criteria

checklistSpecific: Walk senior management through the renewal strategy per treaty and the expected market conditions
Present the target spend against budget and the expected range if the market hardens
Present the retained net position that would result from the target structure
Capture challenges on cost, structure, and panel, and the responses given
Record the changes required before the strategy is submitted for pre-approval

testing.expected: Minutes recording the strategy reviewed, challenges raised, and changes required before pre-approval

checklistGeneric: Roadmap updated after each renewal cycle
checklistSpecific: Update the multi-year structure plan with the actual placed structure as the new baseline
Reflect debrief conclusions on which structural changes to pursue in the next one to three years
Update the assumed multi-year market cycle view and its effect on planned spend
Update planned panel diversification and long-term partner reinsurer relationships
Reissue the roadmap with a version number and note what changed from the previous version

testing.expected: Reissued roadmap with the placed structure as the new baseline and a change note versus the previous version
